messages.content: What are some popular sushi restaurants in Tokyo?

function.name: book_hotel
function.description: Book a hotel room in a specified location for certain dates. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city where the hotel is located.

check_in_date.description: The date when the guest will check into the hotel.

check_out_date.description: The date when the guest will check out from the hotel.

room_type.description: The type of room the guest would prefer. Default: 'double'

message.content:
Here are some of the most popular and highly regarded sushi restaurants in Tokyo, ranging from Michelin‑starred establishments to well‑known local favorites:

| **Sukiyabashi Jiro** | Ginza | Legendary chef Jiro Ono; world‑famous for precision and quality. | 3 |
| **Sushi Saito** | Minato | Intimate setting, 3 Michelin stars, meticulous attention to detail. | 3 |
| **Sushi Yoshitake** | Ginza | 3 Michelin stars, seasonal Omakase with a focus on subtle flavors. | 3 |
| **Sushi Mizutani** | Ginza | 3 Michelin stars, known for its “Sushi of the Year” award. | 3 |
| **Sushi Iwa** | Shinjuku | 2 Michelin stars, renowned for its fresh fish and creative plating. | 2 |
| **Sushi Dai** | Tsukiji Outer Market | Famous for long lines but worth it for fresh tuna and sashimi. | — |
